title: Ztreak: Habit Tracker
subtitle: Build habits at your own pace
description: Track daily, weekly or monthly habits and goals. Follow your streaks, protect an eligible miss and enjoy an optional tower game.
nativeNote: Manual tracking works in your browser. Steps and digital usage require the mobile app and device permissions.

features.title: Choose the frequency
features.text: Set daily goals or quotas for each week, month, or year.

features.title: Shield
features.text: You need an active streak. You have only one shield: two consecutive missed cycles break the streak. A pending record is not a miss.

features.title: Tower · optional
features.text: From completing goals to building with cards.

features.title: Stored data
features.text: Ztreak stores your goals, names, entries, dates, quantities, drafts, preferences and Tower progress on this device. They are used to show your history, calculate streaks and recover changes. Account sign-in is optional. There is no advertising or analytics.

combined.title: One routine.
combined.description: Some days are for a walk, others for a good book. Bring several activities into one goal and choose how many to complete. Consistency can leave room for choice.
combined.hint: Try checking activities and changing how many you need. This example does not save any records.

towerStory.eyebrow: A HOUSE OF CARDS. A LITTLE LIKE LIFE.
towerStory.metaphor: A habit starts with something small. Then comes another, and another. Together they support the life you want to build. That is why we use cards: when one support gives way, it can feel as though everything is shaking.
towerStory.game: In Ztreak, that metaphor becomes an optional game. The goals you choose help you keep building: earn resources, place cards and decide how your tower grows. Each piece gives your consistency a visible shape.
towerStory.collapse: If the streak of a participating goal breaks without shield protection, the structure collapses. Your history, permanent upgrades and what you have learned stay with you for the next build.
towerStory.quote: Rebuilding is part of moving forward.
towerStory.optional: Enjoy the tower, or hide the game and focus on your goals. The choice is yours.
towerStory.alt: The optional house-of-cards tower inside Ztreak

hero.eyebrow: SMALL STEPS. SOMETHING OF YOUR OWN.
title: You don't have to
change everything.
Just begin.
hero.body: That book you want to read. Moving a little more. Making time for yourself again. Give what matters a place in your day and discover what you can build, at your own pace.
hero.note: Try it in your browser. No account needed.
hero.alt: Ztreak Today screen showing several personal goals

title: Make room
for the person you
want to become.
manifesto.body: No two days are the same. Your goals don't have to be either. Ztreak helps you turn an intention into something concrete, record what you do and look back at the path you have taken.

title: There are so many
ways to
move forward.
features.body: Start with what you want to do. Ztreak adapts to how you want to measure it.

items.title: Your life is more than a checkbox.
items.text: A yes or a no. Pages, minutes or kilometres. A minimum to reach or a maximum to respect. Define what matters to you.
items.tag: Custom goals · Quantities · Minimums and maximums

items.title: Consistency has many rhythms.
items.text: Every day or a few days a week. Monthly quotas, yearly commitments and quantities per period. Choose a frequency that fits your life.

items.title: Some things work better together.
items.text: Group activities into a combined goal and choose how many you need to complete. Your routine, with room for choice.

items.title: Less logging. More living.
items.text: On mobile, connect steps or digital usage where your device supports it. You choose the permissions. You can also log activities manually.

items.title: Keep what matters in sight.
items.text: Set reminders and check your goals in mobile app widgets. A small nudge to come back to what you care about.

items.title: Make it yours. Really yours.
items.text: Icons, light and dark themes, language and time zone. Pause or archive a goal when plans change. Share its configuration so someone else can start their own.

history.eyebrow: LOOK AT HOW FAR YOU HAVE COME
title: Sometimes you see
the change by
looking back.
history.body: Your history keeps every record. Check streaks, review quantities and correct a date if you made a mistake. What you have done deserves to last beyond the end of the day.
history.caption: Every mark has a story.
history.alt: A Ztreak goal history with its streak and records
items: History and trends for each goal.
A progress view for the bigger picture.

title: One stumble
doesn't tell
your whole story.
shield.body: With an active streak, the shield can protect an eligible miss. It doesn't erase the miss or turn it into an achievement: it gives you room to pick up the thread.
shield.rule: One shield. Two consecutive missed periods break the streak. A pending record is not a miss.
shield.aria: A protected miss between completed periods

final.eyebrow: YOU DON'T NEED A MONDAY. OR A PERFECT PLAN.
title: Your next step
could be
today.
body: Choose one thing you want to care for.

termsContent.intro: These terms describe the use of Ztreak, its optional features and the management of your account.

sections.title: What Ztreak provides
sections.text: Ztreak, by GameBob, lets you define personal goals, log activities and review your progress. The tower is an optional game. Manual records and goal settings are your responsibility; the app does not guarantee results or replace professional advice.

sections.title: Local use and optional account
sections.text: You can log activities manually without creating an account. Local data stays on the device and web origin where you save it. Clearing browser storage, uninstalling the app or changing devices may affect its availability. Keep an export if you need an independent copy.

sections.title: Device features
sections.text: Steps, digital usage, reminders and widgets depend on the platform, its services and the permissions you grant. The web version does not provide every native capability. You can revoke permissions in your device settings.

sections.title: Premium and subscriptions
sections.text: Purchases are offered through Apple and Google stores, not through this website. Before you confirm a purchase, the store displays the applicable price, duration and renewal terms. Manage and cancel subscriptions in the relevant store. Deleting your Ztreak account does not cancel a subscription.

sections.title: Sync and recovery
sections.text: Sync requires an account, verified Premium access and explicit consent. Signing in alone does not upload your history. See the privacy policy for information about processed data, providers, backups and deletion options.

sections.title: Your records and use of the app
sections.text: Use Ztreak for data you have the right to record and share. Shared goal configurations let another person start their own tracking; they do not make your records public.

determinationStory.eyebrow: THE WORD THAT HOLDS IT ALL TOGETHER
determinationStory.title: Determination.
determinationStory.lead: Discipline can help you follow a plan. Determination connects you to the reason you chose it.
determinationStory.body: Your habits begin with a decision of your own: to care for something that matters to you. That is why Determination is the key word in Ztreak. It means returning to your reason, finding a possible next step and continuing to build when a day goes wrong. Consistency means more when you know what you want to keep going for.
determinationStory.quote: This matters to me. I want to keep building it.
determinationStory.game: In the app, Determination is also the resource you earn by completing your goals.
